{{Top}}
[[File:Twilek_General_SECR.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Jedi General with Republic [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] troopers in [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground warfare]] during the Clone Wars.]]
{{Quote|They're good. No words needed. Perfect sync. Like clones in a way. Better. They're the best. That's why they command.|Republic [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]]|<ref name="Republic 68">[[Republic 68|''Republic'' 68]]</ref>}}
While the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was not a military organization, in times of need its members often became '''Jedi Generals''' to lead [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic military forces]].

==History==
The earliest [[General/Legends|generals]] fought in the [[Mandalorian Wars]] as [[Revanchist]]s, opposing the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusader]] invasion. The end result was them falling to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and forming a [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].

During the [[Great Galactic War]] and following [[Galactic War]], many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] led [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] into battle against the reconstituted [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

Jedi were assigned to serve as generals (some as [[Jedi Lord|Lords]]) of the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Most of those still alive by the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|Seventh Battle]] of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] perished in that battle.

[[File:CompassionateGeneral.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Jedi were thrust into the role of generals during the Clone Wars]]
When Supreme Chancellor Palpatine was granted emergency powers to address the Separatist threat, one of the key outcomes was the centralization of military authority and the establishment of the [[Republic High Command/Legends|Republic High Command]]. This reorganization also integrated the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] with the wartime bureaucracy to support the Republic’s military operations more effectively.<ref name=":0">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

The Jedi Order, which was technically part of the Judicial Department, was significantly affected by this shift. Traditionally serving as peacekeepers and mediators, the Jedi were now reassigned as military officers within the Grand Army of the Republic (GAR) and the Republic Navy. Although the Jedi retained the formal right to refuse direct orders from the Supreme Chancellor—who now acted as Commander-in-Chief—such refusals required substantial justification. Simple appeals to “the will of the Force” were no longer sufficient, and noncompliance could result in accusations of insubordination or even treason.<ref name=":0" />

This new state of affairs often forced Jedi to obey orders that conflicted with their better judgment, and they could not openly question the Chancellor’s intentions without jeopardizing public trust in the Jedi Order's leadership during the war.<ref name=":0" />

One month into the war, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] made the role of the Jedi official.<ref name="NEC" /> And the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] also approved the decision to allow Jedi to become generals.<ref>[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide|''Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide'']]</ref> While there were those who refused to fight with the start of the [[Jedi Schism]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> most [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] were given the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of general during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Order of Battle/Legends|ORBAT]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] accommodated for 80 Jedi Generals in command of [[Corps/Legends|corps]] (along with a [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|clone marshal commander]]) and 320 in command of [[Legion/Legends|legions]] (along with a [[senior clone commander]]). There were also [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi Generals]] in command of the ten [[Systems Army/Legends|Systems Armies]], and [[Senior Jedi General]]s in command of the twenty [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Armies]]. [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] were given the rank of [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] and put in command of each of the army's 1,280 [[Regiment/Legends|regiments]]. There were also Jedi of other rank, such as [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tyneir Renz]].

Some Jedi refused to accept their new military status and left the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order]], while others still chose to work undercover rather than on the battlefield. Many of the Jedi [[Officer/Legends|officers]] [[Death/Legends|died]] during the war against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] killed most of the remaining generals when [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was executed by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].
